historical_record.description: The Recreation and Park Commission urged the Board of Supervisors to acquire about 30 acres on Bayview Hill by eminent domain for public open space.

At a special meeting, the Recreation and Park Commission approved acquiring the undeveloped northeast slope of Bayview Hill as a significant natural resource area, leaving out the level strip along Jamestown Avenue, and pledged to work toward a special use district near the stadium.
